title: The Erdős--Sós Conjecture: A visual exposition of the proof discovered by GPT-6 Astra
summary: The Erdős--Sós theorem states that every graph of average degree greater than $t-2$ contains every tree on $t$ vertices. A short counting proof was discovered by GPT-6 Astra in 2026. We give a visual, reader-centered exposition of that argument whose presentation differs substantially from the original. We recast the counting objects as \emph{early neighbors} in a reveal-and-stop procedure, organize the induction through explicit partitions and reversible swaps, and develop the proof through worked examples with consistent drawings.
